answer: The bug was in `src/inner.rs` within the `try_reserve_entries` function. The condition `if try_add > additional || self.entries.try_reserve_exact(try_add).is_ok()` was incorrectly using an OR (`||`) operator instead of an AND (`&&`) operator. This caused the function to return early even when it shouldn't have, preventing the collection from correctly reserving the requested capacity. Reverting this to `if try_add > additional && self.entries.try_reserve_exact(try_add).is_ok()` fixes the issue.

The bug was in `Core::try_reserve_entries` where the condition `try_add > additional` prevented the code from attempting to reserve exactly enough space when `try_add == additional`. Changing it to `try_add >= additional` ensures that if the current capacity is sufficient to cover the requested `additional` entries, we attempt to reserve up to that capacity.
